adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a new notification fan-out function `sendAddGuestsEmails` in `packages/emails/email-manager.ts` that manually implements organizer + team-member looping and attendee mapping logic (including branching behavior inside the attendee loop). This is a maintainability/architecture concern because similar notification senders typically repeat the same patterns, and the diff already shows inconsistent semantics between templates: `organizer-add-guests-email.ts` builds its subject name from `this.calEvent.attendees[0].name`, while `attendee-add-guests-email.ts` uses `this.calEvent.team?.name || this.calEvent.organizer.name`. This supports the finding’s point about drift/copy-paste risk, but it is not a directly verifiable functional defect from the diff alone.
